title: Four years of secret funding before History Channel

tellings.quote: who I was funding this investigation and keep keeping it completely secret and confidential for 4 years before being persuaded by the History Channel

plain: The owner of Skinwalker Ranch, a Utah property where strange events are reported, says he paid for an investigation of the ranch starting in 2016 and kept it "completely secret and confidential for 4 years" before the History Channel persuaded him to go public. He tells Michels this as his own decision, naming among those involved two men, Jim Segala and Hal Puthoff. He tells it to show the research began quietly, not as a television show.
